answer: Require each agent identity to keep a verifiable work pulse: it must regularly finish small, checkable tasks whose results are publicly attested, and a missed pulse suspends its reputation. Making many fake identities then means sustaining many separate work streams, not just copying keys. A mere echo of old work cannot pass, because each attestation is tied to a fresh task and time window. Honest agents can bridge this proof across services by carrying signed attestations, so reputation stays portable while Sybil farming stays expensive.
